name: appmixer-mcp
description: Build, run and observe Appmixer automation flows from your MCP client.
long_description:
Connects your Appmixer tenant to an MCP client. List, start, stop and troubleshoot flows; inspect execution logs; send app events. Build new automations from a natural-language brief: the server ships an Appmixer flow authoring guide, exposes the connector and component catalogue, validates flows server-side and can dry-run a component before the flow is started. Flows containing a running "MCP Gateway" component contribute their own tools to the session.

Requires an Appmixer tenant and a user account. Prefer an access token over a username and password; a dedicated non-admin user keeps the token's reach limited.

base_url.title: Appmixer API URL
base_url.description: Your tenant's API URL, for example https://api.YOUR_TENANT.appmixer.cloud

access_token.title: Access token
access_token.description: Appmixer access token. Recommended. Leave empty to sign in with a username and password instead.

username.title: Username
username.description: Appmixer username. Only needed without an access token, or to let the server renew an expired one automatically.

password.title: Password
password.description: Appmixer password. Only needed together with the username.

tools.title: Enabled tool groups
tools.description: Comma-separated: "api" for flow and authoring tools, "mcpgateway" for tools published by MCP Gateway components in your flows.

tools.name: list_flows
tools.description: List flows in your Appmixer tenant.

tools.name: get_flow
tools.description: Read a flow's metadata, components and descriptor.

tools.name: create_flow
tools.description: Create a new flow from a flow descriptor.

tools.name: test_flow
tools.description: Dry-run a component with sample input.

tools.name: get_components
tools.description: Inspect connector components, their ports and fields.

tools.name: send_app_event
tools.description: Send an app event to your running flows.
